title: Hardship Settlement Signing Window by Placement Stage
content:
# Hardship Settlement — Stage Shortening of the Signing Window

**Rule.** When a consumer accepts a Hardship Settlement offer of Ridgeline's Settlement Agreements by electronic signature, where the account is at Legal Review Placement or Warehouse Placement, the Hardship Settlement signing window is shortened by 12 days for its stage; where it is at Tertiary Placement or Secondary Placement, by 8 days; an account at Early-Out Placement or Primary Placement takes no stage shortening of the signing window.

The stage is the placement stage the Placed Consumer Accounts record shows for the account.

| Stage group | Stages | Shortening |
|---|---|---|
| Late stages | Legal Review Placement, Warehouse Placement | 12 days |
| Middle stages | Tertiary Placement, Secondary Placement | 8 days |
| Early stages | Early-Out Placement, Primary Placement | none |

## Hypothetical example

A Hardship Settlement on a Secondary Placement account is shortened by 8 days for its stage; the same programme on a Primary Placement account is not shortened for its stage.
